recent_excerpts: ETS breach exposed names, addresses, disability status and test results for all California public school students since 2023 — 5.7 million enrolled in 2025 alone.
Booba ransomware gang claims it stole 344GB from the University of Illinois Chicago College of Medicine, disrupting systems at the school serving 1,300 medical students.
Instructure paid ShinyHunters after two Canvas intrusions stole data from 9,000 institutions. Congress launched an investigation into the ed-tech vendor's incident response.
